title: Sub-byte KV slab packing: FP8/INT8/INT4 compression experiments and live-fallback thresholds
creator: Ava Chen
description: Run a structured set of experiments that evaluate sub-byte and byte-level compression strategies for the KV cache (FP8, INT8, INT4, and hybrid sub-byte packing) to measure actual model-quality regressions and GPU memory improvements under continuous-batching workloads. The goal is to find operationally safe compression profiles and a lightweight, latency-friendly live-fallback policy to ensure customer quality SLAs are maintained while reducing peak GPU memory by at least 18-30% on common sequence distributions.
hypothesis: We expect per-layer low-precision storage (FP8 for attention keys/values, INT8/INT4 for older layers) combined with slab-level packing will reduce KV memory footprint by ~20-30% with <1.5% relative increase in perplexity and negligible downstream semantic drift for short-context workloads. For long-context heavy cohorts, graceful fallback to higher-fidelity slabs will keep regression under 3%.
experiment_matrix: Grid: precisions=[FP8, INT8, INT4, hybrid(FP8+INT8), subbyte-packed-INT4], packing_strategies=[per-layer, per-slab, global], shard_strategies=[replicate, striped], fallback_policy=[static, cohort-adaptive, latency-triggered]. Each run measures latency P50/P95, token throughput, GPU mem peak, perplexity, embedding-sim cosine drift, and downstream task quality (QA F1, summarization ROUGE-L).
datasets: Customer-synth-small (anonymized prompts that stress KV reuse)
acceptance_criteria: At least one compression profile reduces avg peak KV memory >= 18% on open-webtext-mini with P95 latency increase <= 10%
Perplexity regression <= 1.5% on convo-cohort for chosen profile
Fallback rate under cohort-adaptive policy <= 6% on longform-cohort with recovery_time < 50ms
No regression > 3% on customer-synth-small for safety cohorts before rollout
progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff — defined cohorts and initial grid. Allocated two test GPU nodes with monitoring hooks.
2026-02-22: Prototype logics for sub-byte packing implemented in runtime branch feat/kv-packing. Early smoke shows 22% mem reduction for FP8 per-slab packing on small model.
2026-03-01: First full matrix run on medium LLM across 120 jobs completed. Observed larger P95 tail for striping+int4 under bursty arrival patterns.
2026-03-05: Design review with PM & DSE — agreed to drop global INT4 packing for production candidate; focus on hybrid FP8+INT8 and slab-adaptive-int4 only as fallback.
2026-03-10: Integrated cohort-adaptive fallback prototype into request router. Controlled canary shows fallback activation correlates to semantic-sim drop > 2.5%.
2026-03-10: Next: run longform-cohort sweep with larger batch sizes and validate latency SLO under continuous batching.
